name: fl-studio-web-app
description: Front end (lane F, stage F1) for the browser build of the lifted FL engine: Vite + TypeScript, an engine bundle loader, an engine Worker that runs the real emscripten engine, and a Cloudflare Worker that serves large assets from R2. Private; not for public release.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.webworker.json && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc --noEmit -p worker/tsconfig.json
